# Device Battery Status 1.1.0

Stable release for personal use. Packages are unsigned.

- Add the source-backed Razer Viper V4 Pro wireless receiver mapping and correct the response wait for Atheris/Orochi V2. Retain association-aware HyperPolling battery reads and valid battery values when charging queries fail. No new native E6 polling-write profile is enabled.
- Add bounded diagnostic logs with redacted identities and paths, plus Open logs and Export diagnostic report actions.
- Add optional tray icons for selected devices. Single-icon mode remains the default; native categories, unknown and stale readings stay honest.
- Add a per-user installer alongside both portable packages, with saved-data preservation during upgrade and uninstall.
- Add notify-only, manual and off update modes. Checking, verified downloading and installation are separate deliberate actions. The credential-free updater cannot retrieve private releases anonymously; use the signed-in browser fallback for this repository.
- Fix a WPF progress-bar binding failure found by actual rendered smoke testing.

Battery monitoring remains read-only and limited to USB 2.4 GHz. Genuine zero remains valid. Logitech battery categories are never converted into estimated percentages. Existing popup, preferences, alerts and deliberate manual polling controls remain available.

Windows verification passed for source `367ea4165c528b6767522764ce7eef97a4744d15`: compilation, 921 C# cases in each Debug/Release configuration, 5 parser cases, 18 release-policy cases, eight application-smoke checks per portable flavor and 56 installer lifecycle checks. Both downloaded packages and the installer passed independent hash/provenance validation. Verification results and exact source/run provenance are recorded in [the improvement report](https://github.com/kA-sp3R/BatteryStatusCheck/blob/main/docs/improvements-verification.md) and [the source-bound review record](https://github.com/kA-sp3R/BatteryStatusCheck/blob/396a9c1ac74c7bcd34311cdd4a832dca1aeb35b9/.github/reviews/1.1.0.json). Isolated Windows application smoke uses synthetic data, bypasses normal monitoring/HID/network/startup and is separate from installer lifecycle checks. Physical devices, normal monitoring, actual Explorer restart, mixed-monitor DPI, notification delivery, long-run behavior and live update installation remain unverified. The upgrade fixture contains current app bytes with older installer metadata.

The reference projects, revisions, licences and protocol evidence are documented in [reference research](https://github.com/kA-sp3R/BatteryStatusCheck/blob/main/docs/research/reference-projects.md). CLI/API/capture-learning/G Hub extensions remain roadmap items.
